title_en: Murphy Bookcase Door — Middle Hallway Doorway to Laundry Closet
title_es: Puerta Librero Murphy — Puerta Central del Pasillo al Clóset de Lavandería

orientation.viewing_from: Hallway facing middle doorway B (left: bathroom doorway A; right: bedroom opening C)
orientation.pivot_side: LEFT (out-swing into hallway; press right edge inward to release latch, pull outward)
orientation.swing_arc_check: Confirm full 90-degree out-swing against hallway clear width before drilling

nine_point_measurements_b7_b15.instructions: Stand in hallway facing middle doorway B. Measure inside wood jambs excluding outside trim, twice to nearest 1/16". Heights from finished floor. NEVER use bathroom doorway readings (27.25" x 79.375").

case_and_hardware_parameters.hardware_kit: Murphy Door Single Hidden Door Hardware Kit (verify delivery & measure actual hinge stack T + Bt before cutting)
case_and_hardware_parameters.push_latch: Sugatsune ML-ZN80-BL black push latch (confirm delivery; latch height ~40" above floor)
case_and_hardware_parameters.finish_intent: Paint-grade plywood carcass, applied back, 4 fixed shelves with 1-1/2" retaining lips (3/4" above shelf), solid poplar face frame; keep existing crown and casing untouched; Chantilly Lace OC-65 woodwork (sheen TBD).

appliance_and_vent_requirements.appliance: LG WKG101HVA stacked gas WashTower (27" W x 30-3/8" D x 74-3/8" H; delivery Tue Dec 1, 2026)

flagged_clashes.en: Older Nov 2 drawings assume a 28" bathroom pocket door sliding into wall A-B ('no fasteners in pocket cavity'). Per Nov 19 bathroom/SPEC.md, the pocket door is DEFERRED in favor of an outward-swing hinged door — verify actual wall A-B framing on site before placing pivot blocking.
flagged_clashes.es: Los planos del 2 nov suponen una puerta corrediza de baño de 28" dentro del muro A-B. Según bathroom/SPEC.md (19 nov), la corrediza está EN PAUSA — verificar el bastidor real del muro A-B en obra antes de colocar refuerzos de pivote.

flagged_clashes.en: All 9 doorway readings (B7:B15) and kit hinge stack (T, Bt) are UNMEASURED. Zero cutting or drilling until measured and full-size cardboard swing mockup passes.
flagged_clashes.es: Las 9 medidas del vano (B7:B15) y el grosor de bisagras (T, Bt) siguen SIN MEDIR. Cero cortes ni perforaciones hasta medir y aprobar la plantilla de cartón a tamaño real.
